newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHIPPING FIRM IN GAS TANKER JV WITH NORWAY.
newsitem.headline: SHIPPING FIRM IN GAS TANKER JV WITH NORWAY.

text.p: The Latvian Shipping Company (LSC) on Monday said it has approved the creation of a gas tanker operating joint-venture with Norway's Larsen Westfalen Shipping AS, participating with its two new tankers.
"The board has approved LSC participation in this joint venture, buying 50 a percent stake of the JV's stock," Druvis Skulte, LSC board chairman, told a news conference.
LSC, which operates a fleet of 40 tankers, earlier this year launched a 21,500 cubic meter gas tanker and plans to receive another of the same tonnage in July.
The Norwegian shipping firm will use two gas tankers of similar size also suited for transporting liquified gas, LSC said.
The JV, West Gas AS, partners have decided to meet in Riga in September to discuss the operation, Andris Klavinsh, LSC president, said.
"The first ship is currently on its maiden voyage from Japan to Mexico and given the current market situation we are satisfied with the freight rate, " Klavinsh said.
